description: Search available catalog metadata, not image contents. All whitespace-separated terms must match; case and accents are ignored. Use translated terms/synonyms in separate searches as needed. Empty query lists candidates. Results include bounded evidence and opaque five-minute pagination cursors; do not invent IDs. Source completeness is not verified.
name: search_datasets

description: Open a dataset from the catalog by its stable ID.
name: open_dataset

description: Return the active dataset and visualization state.
name: get_application_state

description: Select transfer-function, lit transfer-function, or isovalue rendering.
name: set_render_mode

description: Show or hide the complete dataset bounding box. Local, persistent, and recorded as GSC; independent of clipping and annotation visibility.
name: set_bounding_box

description: Set the local macOS/iOS camera projection. Supply field_of_view_degrees and/or parallel; omitted fields stay unchanged. The field of view also controls equivalent framing in parallel projection. Persists per device, is not synchronized through SharePlay, and is recorded as GSC when recording is active. Unsupported on visionOS.
name: set_screen_projection

description: Set any subset of the current model/view transform.
name: set_transform

description: Rotate the current model/view by an axis-angle delta.
name: rotate_view

description: Set the normalized isovalue in the range zero to one.
name: set_iso_value

description: Set normalized minimum and maximum clipping bounds.
name: set_clipping

description: Set any subset of light direction and RGB light colors.
name: set_lighting

description: Show or hide object annotations (markers, strokes, and placed meshes) or the complete measurement visualization (points, lines, surfaces, and labels) without deleting them. Read application state and list existing annotations before changes. Coordinates are dataset-local [x,y,z] in [0,1], not pixels, world positions or patient axes. Omit id when creating; use a listed UUID when editing. Upsert replaces the complete item: preserve unmodified fields and measurement point IDs. Colors are normalized RGBA in [0,1], not bytes. Lists are paginated; check totalCount and truncated. Never invent anatomical orientation or precise 3D points from an ambiguous 2D view.
name: set_annotation_visibility

description: List sphere markers, stroke markers, and placed mesh instances. Read application state and list existing annotations before changes. Coordinates are dataset-local [x,y,z] in [0,1], not pixels, world positions or patient axes. Omit id when creating; use a listed UUID when editing. Upsert replaces the complete item: preserve unmodified fields and measurement point IDs. Colors are normalized RGBA in [0,1], not bytes. Lists are paginated; check totalCount and truncated. Never invent anatomical orientation or precise 3D points from an ambiguous 2D view.
name: list_objects

description: Create or replace a sphere marker. Positions and radii use normalized volume coordinates. Read application state and list existing annotations before changes. Coordinates are dataset-local [x,y,z] in [0,1], not pixels, world positions or patient axes. Omit id when creating; use a listed UUID when editing. Upsert replaces the complete item: preserve unmodified fields and measurement point IDs. Colors are normalized RGBA in [0,1], not bytes. Lists are paginated; check totalCount and truncated. Never invent anatomical orientation or precise 3D points from an ambiguous 2D view.
name: upsert_sphere_marker

description: Create or replace a stroke marker from normalized volume points. Read application state and list existing annotations before changes. Coordinates are dataset-local [x,y,z] in [0,1], not pixels, world positions or patient axes. Omit id when creating; use a listed UUID when editing. Upsert replaces the complete item: preserve unmodified fields and measurement point IDs. Colors are normalized RGBA in [0,1], not bytes. Lists are paginated; check totalCount and truncated. Never invent anatomical orientation or precise 3D points from an ambiguous 2D view.
name: upsert_stroke_marker

description: Remove one listed sphere, directional or stroke marker by UUID, never a mesh. Read application state and list_objects first. The app confirms deleting the last marker. Only delete on explicit user request.
name: remove_object

description: List all length, area, and volume measurements. Read application state and list existing annotations before changes. Coordinates are dataset-local [x,y,z] in [0,1], not pixels, world positions or patient axes. Omit id when creating; use a listed UUID when editing. Upsert replaces the complete item: preserve unmodified fields and measurement point IDs. Colors are normalized RGBA in [0,1], not bytes. Lists are paginated; check totalCount and truncated. Never invent anatomical orientation or precise 3D points from an ambiguous 2D view.
name: list_measurements

description: Create or replace a measurement from normalized volume points. Read application state and list existing annotations before changes. Coordinates are dataset-local [x,y,z] in [0,1], not pixels, world positions or patient axes. Omit id when creating; use a listed UUID when editing. Upsert replaces the complete item: preserve unmodified fields and measurement point IDs. Colors are normalized RGBA in [0,1], not bytes. Lists are paginated; check totalCount and truncated. Never invent anatomical orientation or precise 3D points from an ambiguous 2D view.
name: upsert_measurement

description: Remove one measurement by UUID. Read state and the relevant annotation lists first. Bulk deletion and deletion of the last item require local human approval; a model-supplied confirm flag cannot grant permission. Never bypass a declined deletion with individual calls.
name: remove_measurement

description: Remove all markers and/or measurements in the current dataset, preserving placed meshes. Requires explicit confirmation. The native AI client additionally requires a fresh local human approval; a model-supplied confirm flag is not human approval. Read state and the relevant annotation lists first. Bulk deletion and deletion of the last item require local human approval; a model-supplied confirm flag cannot grant permission. Never bypass a declined deletion with individual calls.
name: clear_annotations

description: Wait for a frame newer than the supplied frame number.
name: wait_until_rendered

description: Read a zero-based channel's TF as an ordered array of straight RGBA bytes (0...255). RGB/RGBA volumes have no TFs. Returned samples are a uniformly spaced preview across [0,1], at most 256 entries. originalSampleCount is the full table size; samplesArePreview marks approximate previews. This does not reduce the actual TF resolution.
name: get_transfer_function

description: Set a zero-based channel's TF. Each sample is four integer bytes [R,G,B,A] in 0...255. A compact ramp is linearly resampled to the current TF resolution. Other channels remain unchanged; updates render immediately and synchronize through SharePlay. Returned samples are a uniformly spaced preview across [0,1], at most 256 entries. originalSampleCount is the full table size; samplesArePreview marks approximate previews. This does not reduce the actual TF resolution.
name: set_transfer_function

description: Read mode and primary/secondary RGBA colors (0...1). visionOS uses passthrough.
name: get_background

description: Set system, solid or vertical gradient background on macOS/iOS. Primary is the solid/top RGBA color, secondary the bottom RGBA color (0...1); omitted colors are unchanged. visionOS supports only passthrough.
name: set_background

description: Capture a PNG. include_alpha defaults to true (transparent render image, background omitted). False composites the configured screen background; visionOS uses black instead of passthrough. Optionally save to absolute sandbox-accessible output_path; existing files require overwrite:true.
name: capture_screenshot
